advanced_active_hours_hint: Uses the server's timezone. An end time before the start time runs overnight.
advanced_allow_bots: Respond to bots instead of people
advanced_allow_bots_hint: Only matches messages from other bots and webhooks. Never its own.
advanced_allow_target_hint: Lets people add a name after the trigger, used by %target%.
advanced_category_hint: Group related triggers so you can turn them all on or off at once.
advanced_chain_hint: Runs a second trigger by ID after this one. It still checks its own rules. 0 for none.
advanced_counter_hint: Counters are shared across the server. Read or change one from a response with {read}, or {add} to add one.
advanced_delete_trigger_hint: Removes what the person typed once the trigger fires.
advanced_delete_trigger_hint_blocked: Unavailable while reacting to the message, since there would be nothing left to react to.
advanced_event_channel_hint: Joins and boosts have no channel of their own, so pick one here or they will not respond.
advanced_event_hint: Lets this trigger format another feature's announcement, with all the same options.
advanced_extra_responses_hint: One per line. Repeat a line to make it more likely to be picked.
advanced_fail_message: Message when they cannot use it
advanced_fail_message_hint: Shown when someone cannot afford the cost or is below the required level.
advanced_hours_days_hint: No days selected means every day.
advanced_match_anywhere_hint: Off means the whole message has to be the trigger.
advanced_max_uses_hint_one: Used {count} time so far. 0 means no limit.
advanced_max_uses_hint_other: Used {count} times so far. 0 means no limit.
advanced_min_age_hint: These keep brand new accounts from using a trigger. Leave at 0 for no restriction.
advanced_no_message_hint: Useful when the trigger only exists to hand out roles or run another trigger.
advanced_owner_only_hint: Nobody else can use it, including server administrators.
advanced_prefix_server_if_set: Server prefix if one is set
advanced_react_emoji_hint: Separate with spaces. Up to six, added one per second.
advanced_react_instead_hint: Puts the trigger's emoji on their message rather than on the reply.
advanced_react_instead_hint_blocked: Unavailable while deleting the triggering message.
advanced_reply_to_message_hint: Shows the response as a reply so it is clear what it answered.
advanced_section_counter_hint: Only fire within a counter range
advanced_section_event_hint: Respond to level ups, joins and more
advanced_section_limits_hint: Cooldowns, expiry and who may use it
advanced_section_matching_hint: Prefix, position and who may use it
advanced_send_as_dm: Send the response as a DM
advanced_send_as_dm_hint: Replies privately instead of in the channel.
page_advanced_create_hint: All required fields must be filled with valid data
page_advanced_regex_test_placeholder: Enter text to test against your regex
page_advanced_regex_tooltip: Test your regex pattern against sample text to ensure it matches correctly and prevents unexpected behavior.
page_advanced_response_placeholder: Click to configure response message with embeds/components
page_advanced_response_tooltip: Supports rich content including plain text, JSON embeds with images/fields/colors, interactive components, and placeholders like %user.name%. Try the Rich Embeds template!
page_advanced_trigger_placeholder: Enter trigger text or regex pattern
page_advanced_types_hint: Select which types of interactions can trigger this response
page_advanced_types_tooltip: Choose how this trigger activates: Messages (regular chat), Slash Commands (requires setup), Buttons (interactive), or Reactions (emoji responses). Multiple types can be enabled.
page_announce_auto_delete_disabled: Auto-delete disabled - cannot be used with react to trigger
page_announce_interaction_enabled: Interaction triggers enabled for slash command
page_announce_message_enabled: Message triggers enabled - at least one trigger type is required
page_announce_react_disabled: React to trigger disabled - cannot be used with auto-delete
page_confirm_delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete the trigger "{name}"?
page_counters_hint: Counters are shared across the server. A response reads one with {read}, or adds to it with {add}.
page_edit_trigger_hint: Text that will trigger this response
page_empty_hint: Create your first trigger using the quick setup above
page_notify_both_required: Both trigger text and response are required
page_placeholders_hint: Drop any of these into a response and the bot fills them in when the trigger fires. Regex triggers can also use {capture} for capture groups.
page_quick_create_hint: Creates a simple trigger that responds when users type your trigger text
page_quick_response_hint: 💡 Supports rich embeds, interactive buttons, select menus, and Discord formatting
page_quick_response_placeholder: Click to configure response message with rich embeds and components
page_quick_trigger_hint: Simple text that will trigger the response
page_regex_result_placeholder: Enter test string to see results
page_subtitle: Create and manage automated responses to messages
page_template_embed_desc: Rich embeds with images, fields, and components
page_template_simple_desc: Bot says X when users type Y
page_test_hint: Checks whether a message would fire this trigger, as you. Nothing is sent, charged or counted.
page_test_no_match: The message does not match this trigger's text, prefix or pattern.
page_test_would_fire: This message would fire the trigger.
